sn37.4:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.4:1.3: idha bhikkhave mātugāmo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati.
sn37.4:1.4: majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ issā pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati.
sn37.4:1.6: imehi kho bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
